description: Na₂Sn₃O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.75 Å. There are three inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-52°. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.18 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.18 Å. In the third Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.23 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Sn atoms to form distorted ONa₂Sn₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃Sn₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Sn₂ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent ONa₂Sn₃ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₂Sn₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Sn atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Sn atoms to form distorted ONa₂Sn₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four ONa₃Sn₂ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Sn₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Sn₃ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three equivalent ONa₃Sn₂ square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and three equivalent Sn atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Sn atoms to form ONa₃Sn₂ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Sn₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Sn₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Sn₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with five ONa₂Sn₃ square pyramids, and edges with three equivalent ONa₂Sn₂ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Sn atoms to form distorted ONa₂Sn₃ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃Sn₂ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Sn₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Sn₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three ONa₃Sn₂ square pyramids, and edges with three equivalent ONa₂Sn₃ trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Sn atoms.
